name: Morten Christensen
bio:
Morten's culinary journey began in his grandmother's kitchen in rural Denmark, where he learned the art of traditional Danish baking and preserving. He spent years honing his skills in various restaurants across Scandinavia before a chance encounter with a racing team during a promotional event sparked his interest in motorsport catering. He was fascinated by the logistical challenges and the pressure to deliver high-quality meals under tight deadlines.

He approaches his role with a blend of Danish efficiency and a deep understanding of dietary needs. Morten is known for his ability to create customized menus that cater to the diverse preferences and nutritional requirements of the RCR team. He is meticulous about sourcing the freshest ingredients and ensuring that every meal is not only delicious but also contributes to the team's peak performance. His commitment to excellence and innovative approach to catering set him apart.

At RCR, Morten is more than just a catering manager; he's a culinary diplomat, fostering camaraderie and team spirit through his thoughtfully prepared meals. His knack for creating a welcoming atmosphere in the paddock dining area has made him a beloved figure among the team members.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: A stocky man with a friendly face and a perpetually cheerful demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with recipes and menu ideas.
Insists on using only Danish butter in his pastries.
Secretly practices his Formula 1 pit stop skills with trays of food during his downtime.
